name: dotted-glow-background

frames.best_why: Frame 4 catches the dot field at a bright moment with the demo card still fully readable.

tagline: A near-black field of tiny dots that twinkle and pick up a faint blue glow.
summary: Covers its area with a staggered grid of tiny round dots on near-black. Each dot brightens and dims on its own rhythm, and the brightest gain a soft blue halo, so the whole field shimmers.
appearance: A near-black stage filled edge to edge with a fine grid of tiny round dots, offset row from row. Most dots sit dim grey with a few brighter ones scattered like faint stars, and a dark rounded card with a heading, paragraph and two buttons floats in the centre.
behaviour: Each dot pulses between dim and bright on its own phase and speed, and the brightest briefly gain a soft blue glow. The field keeps shimmering in place indefinitely and never reacts to the pointer.
demo_content: "Ready to buy Pro?" card with a license paragraph and Get Pro / Browse components buttons.
search_phrases: dots that pulse with a blue glow
subtle animated background for a cta
canvas dots fading in and out
use_when: A call-to-action or hero needs a quiet moving backdrop behind a card, cheap enough to leave running.
avoid_when: It is tuned for dark surfaces, and the loop never stops while on screen.
customise: Dot spacing and radius, dot and glow colours including theme variants, overall opacity and pulse speeds are props; there is no content to supply.
weight_why: Draws several thousand dots per frame, though it pauses once scrolled out of view.

a11y.note: The decorative canvas carries no aria-hidden or role, and the endless shimmer ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: The dots are very low contrast, so the shimmer nearly vanishes on a bright display.
The animation loop runs for as long as the layer is on screen.
polish_why: Restrained and evenly spaced, but the dots are so faint the field reads almost black.
title: Dotted Glow Background
